Initial release of the documentation-only skill for APIDot Seedance 2 API.

- Provides comprehensive integration guidance for Seedance 2 workflows through APIDot, including async job handling and webhooks.
- Documents when and how to use the Seedance 2 API for video generation from prompts, images, audio, or references.
- Establishes strict security practices for handling APIDot API keys and sensitive data.
- Includes model-specific links to APIDot docs, quickstart guides, examples, and support resources.
- No executable code, automation, or bundled clients—documentation only.
